qa.question: Can this follower, which has "This can't be destroyed by abilities," be buried by abilities such as Yuzuki, Righteous Demon's Fanfare ability?

qa.title: Q2107 (May 15, 2026)
qa.question: When playing Rimewind, can I select an enemy advanced follower?
qa.answer: Yes. Advanced followers are also considered unevolved followers.

qa.title: Q2106 (May 15, 2026)
qa.question: When playing Biofabrication, can I select a faceup advanced follower in my evolve deck?
qa.answer: No. Advanced followers are not evolved followers.

qa.title: Q2105 (May 15, 2026)
qa.question: What is ability damage?
qa.answer: Ability damage is all damage except for damage dealt by two followers in combat or by a follower attacking a leader. Damage from Strike abilities, although triggered by an attack, is considered ability damage.
